description: Owner only: execute the exact reviewed project_data_plan after explicit customer confirmation. Pass its change, resource_etag as if_match and confirmation_token with one idempotency_key; confirmed must be true. The operation never copies data. Read operation_get until terminal; after uncertainty reuse the same key, and never start another reset or data change with a new key just to retry. reset_dev requires isolated data, and sharing requires an existing Prod database. Deleted Dev data/files cannot be restored by reversing the mode.
